mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, which in turn results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the federal funds rate increased by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a quarter indicates weakening labor market conditions, which leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the unemployment rate increased by more than 0.5% within a quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts over three consecutive months signals a strengthening demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and increased corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where housing starts increased for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production by more than 1% over two consecutive months signals a contraction in supply, leading to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where industrial production declined by more than 1% over two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month, it signals a tight labor market and strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS increase > 200,000 in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the unemployment rate is below 4% and nonfarm payrolls increase by more than 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3% within a month indicates strong consumer demand and a robust labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increase and UNRATE decrease > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where RSAFS increases and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.3% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with an increase in consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% within a month signals inflationary pressure with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decrease and CPIAUCSL increase > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS decreases and CPIAUCSL increases by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals strong economic growth, which leads to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where GDP increased over two consecutive quarters.
